objective: Rebuild faithful Swarm internal architecture documentation with Rust engine, identity, memory/context, supervision, logs/telemetry and evidence boundaries.

replan.original_defect: Two reduced diagrams and a generic crate map omitted essential internal contracts. Go memory labeling conflated architecture with historical implementation evidence. Earlier corrections restored engine visibility without restoring the missing identity, memory, supervision and observability mechanisms.
options: Keep patching labels in the same reduced views.
Reconstruct separate contract views from named internal sections and retain a component/source map plus a separate maturity matrix.
replan.decision: Reconstruction: five bilingual views, with a source-mapped catalogue and current status kept separate.
replan.reproducer_scope: Previous active Mermaid files only, not the full original Swarm documentation. Marker absence supports the observed presentation gap; markers alone do not establish semantic fidelity.
replan.recovery: Read the relevant sections of identity, memory/dialogue, supervision, logs, traceability, calls, liveness, review evidence and current native status before redrawing.

semantic_boundaries: Human source, principal, logical agent, execution instance, owner and author remain distinct.
Signed enrollment payload, current human authority, exact publication permit, SQLite registry and independent Trust checkpoint are separate.
Configuration/witness and their private transport are separate from public agent admission; before-plan authority remains explicit and open.
Memory includes versioned knowledge, received/prepared context, task history, extractive choices, instruction revisions, dialogue boundary and explicit recovery.
read/summarize/transmit require exact sources and recipient; final public enforcement is not declared complete.
Owner inboxes and actual input_events bind run observations and decisions; leases, generation, revision, attempt and budgets remain checked.
continue-run retains counters; stop-run requires actual termination confirmation. Structured inference guards and cycle judgment remain separate.
Logs, terminal, events, OTLP, Linux metrics and call records retain provenance; console and exports remain read-only.
Candidate checks, independent review, global cycle judgment and acceptance remain distinct; evidence freshness is retained.
Architecture diagrams do not classify memory as a Go subsystem; native maturity and historical proof language remain in a separate matrix.

visual_recovery.action: Moved preparation authority to the origin group, matching its source role; current SVG/PNG retain native dimensions.

visual_recovery.action: Represented the same two-way contracts with one bidirectional labeled connection; registry supplies the current snapshot directly to decision checks while actor/grant objects remain explicit.
visual_recovery.verification: Final overview and identity PNG inspected; all views parsed and all required node IDs/source references retained.
